description:
Run a C# state machine across Unity Editor frames for runtime debugging or inspection. Private/internal members are accessible directly without reflection when enable_non_public_access is enabled (default). Project/package namespaces are resolved automatically where unambiguous; qualify ambiguous types.

request_editor_status selects the required state. Locus compiles before applying configured state-change permissions. Runs have no wall-clock timeout; Locus owns frame and output limits. Plan mode blocks state-machine execution.

Each state has variables created once per run and shared by that state's start/update/end. start runs on entry, update once per awake frame, and end before leaving. Returning from update already yields a frame. Keep main-thread snippets short; avoid blocking waits and polling loops.

Context:
- ctx.Print(value) records findings. ctx.Done(message) or Done() succeeds; ctx.Fail(message) fails.
- ctx.Goto(name) changes state. ctx.Sleep(frames) ends the tick and skips that many future update ticks; use it for intentional throttling.
- ctx.Global<T>(key, initialValue) returns a shared handle with Value; initialization happens only for a missing key. The key-only overload uses default(T). SetGlobal/GetGlobal<T>/HasGlobal/RemoveGlobal manage shared values; Set/Get<T>/Has/Remove are aliases.
- ctx.PromptUser(token, message) and ClearPrompt(token) show/clear non-blocking hints; verify user actions through Unity state.
- StateName, TotalFrames, ElapsedFramesInState, TotalSeconds, and ElapsedSecondsInState expose timing.

ctx.Print returns up to 100000 estimated tokens inline. Larger output up to 1000000 estimated tokens is saved under Library/Locus/RunStates and reported as result_file; larger output is not saved. Follow the returned output metadata.

For profiler APIs and sampling workflows, find skill/profiler.md through knowledge_query, then use `read` with the returned path and line range unless already loaded.

request_editor_status.description: Required Unity Editor state. Locus applies configured state-change permissions before running.

initial_state.description: Name of the first state to enter.

enable_non_public_access.description: Allow this call to directly access private and internal types, APIs, and fields without reflection. Defaults to true and is also governed by the global Hot Reload & Compile setting.

variables.description: Optional C# local declarations shared by this state's start, update, and end snippets. Other states cannot read these locals. This snippet has no ctx parameter.

start.description: Optional C# code executed when entering this state.

update.description: C# code executed every Unity frame while this state is awake.

end.description: Optional C# code executed before leaving this state or finishing.
